title: Sparkly paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFE066">
    <!-- Top left sparkle -->
    <path d="M18 12 L20 18 L26 20 L20 22 L18 28 L16 22 L10 20 L16 18 Z"/>
    <!-- Top right sparkle -->
    <path d="M82 8 L84 14 L90 16 L84 18 L82 24 L80 18 L74 16 L80 14 Z"/>
    <!-- Bottom left sparkle -->
    <path d="M12 78 L14 83 L19 85 L14 87 L12 92 L10 87 L5 85 L10 83 Z"/>
    <!-- Bottom right sparkle -->
    <path d="M88 72 L90 77 L95 79 L90 81 L88 86 L86 81 L81 79 L86 77 Z"/>
    <!-- Small sparkles -->
    <path d="M50 6 L51 9 L54 10 L51 11 L50 14 L49 11 L46 10 L49 9 Z"/>
    <path d="M94 45 L95 48 L98 49 L95 50 L94 53 L93 50 L90 49 L93 48 Z"/>
    <path d="M6 45 L7 48 L10 49 L7 50 L6 53 L5 50 L2 49 L5 48 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Palette body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="38" ry="30" fill="#C8A165" stroke="#E0C080" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Palette inner lighter area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="32" ry="25" fill="#D8B880"/>
  <!-- Thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="72" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#8B6A3E" stroke="#A08050" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Thumb hole inner shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="73" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="#6B4A26"/>

  <!-- Paint blobs -->
  <!-- Red blob -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="42" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#E84040"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="40" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FF7060"/>

  <!-- Blue blob -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="38" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#4080E8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#70B0FF"/>

  <!-- Yellow blob -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="45" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#F0D030"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="43" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#FFF070"/>

  <!-- Green blob -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="62" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#40C060"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="60" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#70E090"/>

  <!-- Purple blob -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="58" rx="6.5" ry="5" fill="#A050D0"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="56" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#C080FF"/>

  <!-- Orange blob -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="52" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="#F09030"/>
  <ellipse cx="53" cy="50" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FFB060"/>

  <!-- Paintbrush -->
  <rect x="76" y="28" width="4" height="30" rx="1.5" fill="#D0A060" transform="rotate(25 78 43)"/>
  <rect x="75.5" y="27" width="5" height="6" rx="1" fill="#B08040" transform="rotate(25 78 30)"/>
  <!-- Brush tip with paint -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="26" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#E84040" transform="rotate(25 80 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="79" cy="24" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#FF7060" transform="rotate(25 79 24)"/>

  <!-- Drip of paint from palette -->
  <path d="M28 80 Q27 86 28 90 Q29 92 30 90 Q31 86 30 80" fill="#4080E8"/>
</svg>
